professionalSummary: Platform Engineer with three years of ownership over the credit workflow system runtime platform, responsible for production configuration changes, infrastructure code, deployment pipelines, and leading the weekly platform change review.
experienceHighlights: Owns the runtime platform end-to-end and decides/executed production configuration changes (src_f165952eca9b, src_9c3c487d7310).
Builds and maintains infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm) and deployment pipelines (src_2188d3a8829b).
Leads the weekly platform change review and records decisions (src_0b27640386fa).
Coordinates changes with application team and security, recording responsibility boundaries (src_df7b4047219c).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Platform ownership entry in the engineering service catalogue and change records for one month showing approval and execution under the candidate's user id (src_64c61c8bd26c).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm ownership, production change execution, infrastructure code, pipelines, and change review leadership, but do not provide evidence of runbook documentation or hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

Reference call with the former head of platform engineering: confirmed the candidate was the platform's named owner, decided and executed production changes and led the change review; confirmed employment dates.
Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.
Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.

Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.

missingEvidence: Documentation of runbooks, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each platform change.
